sloka: स राम: स्वर्गतं श्रुत्वा पितरं पृथिवीपतिम् ।उवाच भरतं वाक्यं धर्मात्मा धर्मसंहितम् ॥ २.१०२.७॥
transliteration: sa rāma: svargataṁ śrutvā pitaraṁ pṛthivīpatim ।uvāca bharataṁ vākyaṁ dharmātmā dharmasaṁhitam ॥ 2.102.7॥

translations.english: On hearing that his father, king Dasaratha, the lord of the world had attained heaven, righteous Rama said to Bharata in conformty with his rightful conduct.
